data.name: App.Title
data.comment: Application bar title for the dashboard. Keep the product name GlobalDesk; translate what follows the dash.

data.name: Dashboard.Welcome
data.comment: Heading on the dashboard page.

data.name: Dashboard.Subtitle
data.value: Your service desk at a glance
data.comment: Line under the heading. Not shown on the Module 1 screen; kept so the neutral file is complete.

data.name: Navigation.Customers
data.comment: Navigation button caption. A noun (the list of customers), not the verb.

data.name: Navigation.Tickets
data.comment: Navigation button caption. A noun.

data.name: Preview.Title
data.comment: Header of the panel that shows how the session's culture writes a date, a number and an amount.

data.name: Preview.Date
data.comment: Caption beside the formatted date.

data.name: Preview.Count
data.comment: Caption beside the formatted number. A count of units, not a size.

data.name: Preview.Amount
data.comment: Caption beside the formatted currency. A sum of money.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Name
data.comment: Field label - reused by two screens.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Save
data.comment: Button caption. The imperative verb, not the noun.

data.name: CustomerEditor.Saved
data.comment: Confirmation after a successful save. One whole sentence.

data.name: Validation.Required
data.comment: Validation message, one whole sentence.

data.name: App.ProductName
data.comment: The product name. Marked invariant: it is the same word in every language and must never come back translated.

data.name: Customer.LastOrder
data.comment: One whole sentence. {0} is the customer name, {1} the date of the last order, already formatted for the reader. Both placeholders must appear; German moves {1} into the middle and the verb to the end.

data.name: Validation.Email
data.comment: Validation message when the address does not parse. One whole sentence, imperative.

data.name: Dashboard.Language
data.comment: Caption above the language picker. A noun.

data.name: Language.en-US
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Marked invariant: a language list shows every language in its own language, so this value is the same in every resource file.

data.name: Language.de-DE
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Language.fr-CA
data.comment: Entry in the language picker. Invariant - see Language.en-US.

data.name: Status.SessionCulture
data.comment: Status strip. {0} is a culture name such as de-DE and is never translated.

data.name: Status.EditorRecreated
data.comment: Status note after a language switch rebuilt the designer-localized editor.

data.name: Editor.Recreated
data.comment: Badge on the editor panel, lower case: this instance was built for the culture the session is on now.

data.name: Editor.Stale
data.comment: Badge on the editor panel. {0} is the culture name the instance was built for, which is no longer the session culture. Keep it short - the badge is a pill.
